cases.note: Warm and under the threshold. Nothing is given up.
Above the throttle point for four seconds. The three housekeeping rungs go and DEGRADED does not: a thermal transient from one heavy motion is not a degraded robot.
Thirty seconds. §36.3 raises DEGRADED, which is the impaired *running* state — leases are still granted, because a robot that stops for being warm is a robot nobody deploys.
